meta.title: Certificate Expiry Tracking: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Certificate Expiry Tracking is not represented by any catalog step.
Growth versus Enterprise plan availability cannot be selected or asserted because no plan-tier step is available.
Staged reminders and automatic blocking cannot be configured or observed with the catalog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Certificate Expiry Tracking is not represented by any catalog step.; Growth versus Enterprise plan availability cannot be selected or asserted because no plan-tier step is available.; Staged reminders and automatic blocking cannot be configured or observed with the catalog.

args.need: sign in as the MDM / Master Data Team on the Growth tenant and the Enterprise tenant, use Certificate Expiry Tracking on both, and verify that Growth refuses or hides it while Enterprise allows staged reminders and automatic blocking

steps.note: A tester must exercise the unavailable certificate-tracking feature across the two plan tiers.
Confirm the resulting screen has no visible crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed values.
